svg.title: iOS · Shape-mation · builder · family · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Shapemation/ShapemationBuilderView.swift (ShapemationBuilderView, the shape step of the shape-slideshow builder — step 2 since Apply filters went in front of it on 2026-09-20) over ShapemationBuilder and Kit/Shapes/ShapeRegister.swift (DetectedShape.Family: title + symbolName). First drawn 2026-09-11 from the running app; redrawn 2026-09-20 from the Debug build on the iPhone 16 Pro simulator over an APFS clone of the tram library (LL_SHAPEMATION=build LL_CHIPS=tram, then Next · shape), the copy checked against the Mac Debug build's AX dump. Pushed inside the Shape-mation sheet (ShapemationHomeView, opened from the Create tab's Create Shape-mation row), which owns its NavigationStack the way Presets does — so the nav bar is a back chevron + "Apply filters" in accent (was "Back" to the home before the filters step existed), then the large title "Shape slideshow". Body is a ScrollView: the question "Which shape holds still?" (17 semibold), then — NEW 2026-09-20 — one secondary trail line (13) when a filter is on: the lit tags' labels, any search words quoted, and the filtered count, joined by " · " — here "Tram · 164 photos"; no line at all with nothing lit. Then one white llCard (radius 18) with a row per family that has at least one register entry AMONG THE FILTERED PROJECTS — in DetectedShape.Family.allCases order (Circle, Oval, Square, Rectangle), each a NavigationLink to the Match step: the family's SF Symbol (circle / oval / square / rectangle, 17 semibold, accent, in a 30×30 frame), the title (16), a Spacer, then "N project(s) · M" (13 secondary — N = filtered projects holding at least one instance of the family, M = instances across their registers) and chevron.right (13 semibold, tertiary). Rows are padded 16 horizontal / 13 vertical, so each is 56 pt tall; a Divider padded 58 from the leading edge follows EVERY row, including the last one — which is why a hairline sits on the card's bottom edge, drawn here as shipped. Not drawn: the loading spinner before the registers are read, and the empty card, which since 2026-09-20 reads "No shapes in the register among these N photos. Loosen the filters, or run Find shapes first." Sample data is the tram library on 2026-09-20: Circle 1 project · 1, Square 1 project · 1, Rectangle 83 projects · 84 — no oval in the register, so no Oval row. Measured from the 402×874-pt simulator capture and re-anchored to this 393×852 canvas as the other builder steps are: top-anchored content follows the 59-pt safe top (the capture's 62), trailing edges sit 9 pt further left; the sheet's top at safe-top + 10 (69).
svg.text: iOS · Shape-mation · builder · family · portrait · 393×852 pt
mirrors ShapemationBuilderView (shape step) — Which shape holds still? · Tram · 164 photos · Circle · Square · Rectangle · in the Shape-mation sheet
